artifacts.description: feat(qa): plot solved sketches to PNG with swx-qa sketch
fix(qa): keep sketch labels inside small plots

acceptance_criteria: A library function in swx-qa (e.g. sketch::plot(&Sketch, &PlotOptions) -> Result<Image, String>) draws, top-down with x right and y up, and uniformly scaled to fit the image with a margin of at least 5% per side: lines, circles and arcs (arcs counter-clockwise from a0 to a1), and point entities and line endpoints as dots of at least 3 px.

Dimension values: each Distance, Radius and Diameter constraint is labeled with its value (up to 3 decimals, trailing zeros trimmed; R prefix for radius, Ø for diameter) near the midpoint of the dimensioned points (distance) or the entity (radius/diameter).

CLI: swx-qa sketch --fixture <name> -o <out.png> [--size WxH] with at least two built-in fixtures, each solved before plotting: rectangle (40 × 25 rectangle from the M2-03 combined test, from a perturbed start) and triangle-345 (3-4-5 right triangle with two distances). --help lists them. An unknown fixture, a missing -o, or a bad --size returns an error message and a non-zero exit, not a panic.
Determinism: plotting the same fixture twice gives byte-identical PNGs (test).

Geometry test: for rectangle at 400x300, the four corner dots land within 2 px of the pixel positions computed from the solved coordinates and the fit transform, and a pixel on each side's midpoint is drawn (not background).

Text test: the label for a distance of 40 contains non-background pixels within 20 px of the bottom side's midpoint; the glyph table has a glyph for every character the labeler can emit (test iterates the formatter's output for sample values 0.5, 25, 40, 123.456).
Empty sketch: plot returns a valid image (background only) or a clear error; documented either way; no panic, no division by zero.
swx-qa still builds and tests without --features occt; no unsafe; no new third-party dependencies; the ADR line is added.
cargo fmt --all --check && cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings && cargo test --workspace passes.
QA report (FACTORY §6b) posted on the PR, with the rectangle and triangle-345 PNGs as its visuals.
